_comment: adcert campaign config. 'reviewers' maps a group to a reviewer's sam; members of unmapped groups route to their own AD manager attribute. '_escalation' receives entries where the mapped reviewer would be certifying their own access. 'plain_language' is what the supervisor reads for each group - write it in business terms, not technical ones. The optional 'compliance' block maps the evidence report to whatever framework you report against (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, NIST, or internal audit); omit it to use the generic default.

compliance.summary: Evidences periodic review of user access rights and enforcement of least privilege, supporting access-recertification controls found in SOC 2 (CC6.1-CC6.3), ISO 27001 (A.5.18), HIPAA Security Rule (164.308(a)(4)), PCI DSS (Req. 7), and NIST 800-53 (AC-2).

smtp._comment: Used only by 'adcert.ps1 send'. Reviewer addresses come from each account's AD mail attribute. Always try -DryRun first.
smtp.subject: Access review due: {campaign}
